name: main-write-lock
title: Implement the main write lock for DONE / B-META / shared-main writes
description: Implement the main write lock — session-ownership-and-write-leases.md rollout step 3. Serialize all shared-main mutating command entry points (story_advance DONE merge/cleanup, gap_log + B-META finding writes, audit --framework writes, story_create, done_recover, main-mirror metadata updates) behind one global, atomic, stale-reclaimable lock. Critically this story must fix B-META-framework-audit:F-008 — the DONE flow self-blocks its own merge by writing stale main-mirror story metadata — so the fix requires in-lock idempotency and stale-main-mirror handling, not merely serialization. Add doctor + multi-session smoke coverage proving partial-DONE no longer arises from a stale main-mirror self-block. Reconcile lock storage with the existing .koala/runtime/done-main-merge.lock (migrate/alias/compat). Explicitly out of scope: story owner lease, takeover, and session_brief ownership UX — those are the second implementation story.
